hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then echo '[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access' >&2; echo '[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev "cargo run"' >&2; echo '[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev' >&2; exit 2; fi

#!/bin/bash
if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then echo '[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence' >&2; echo '[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev' >&2; fi

#!/bin/bash
d=$(cat); p=$(echo "$d" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+'); if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ]; then dir=$(dirname "$(realpath "$p")"); while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ] && break; dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ] && cargo fmt --manifest-path "$dir/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; fi; printf '%s' "$d"

#!/bin/bash
d=$(cat); p=$(echo "$d" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+'); if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ]; then dir=$(dirname "$(realpath "$p")"); while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ] && break; dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; if [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ]; then out=$(cargo clippy --manifest-path "$dir/Cargo.toml" --message-format=short -- -D warnings 2>&1); bn=$(basename "$p"); echo "$out" | grep "$bn" | head -10 >&2; fi; fi; printf '%s' "$d"

#!/bin/bash
d=$(cat); p=$(echo "$d" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+'); if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ]; then matches=$(grep -n 'dbg!(' "$p" | grep -v '//.*noqa' | head -5); if [ -n "$matches" ]; then echo "[Hook] WARNING: dbg!() found in $p" >&2; echo "$matches" >&2; echo '[Hook] Remove dbg!() before committing' >&2; fi; fi; printf '%s' "$d"

#!/bin/bash
cat; echo '[Hook] Test run completed - review results above' >&2

#!/bin/bash
files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep '\.rs$'); if [ -n "$files" ]; then found=0; for f in $files; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; matches=$(grep -nE '(dbg!|todo!|unimplemented!)\(' "$f" | grep -v '//.*noqa' | head -5); if [ -n "$matches" ]; then echo "[Hook] Debug macros in $f:" >&2; echo "$matches" | sed 's/^/  /' >&2; found=1; fi; done; [ $found -eq 1 ] && echo '[Hook] Remove debug macros before committing' >&2; fi
